Regular = regularPrice of in-stock colorways with priceType R, or P without a markdown, clearance, final-sale or 'price as marked' flag; priceType M (the API's 'Clearance') excluded. 13 legging styles qualify: $89 (Elation Ultra High Rise Legging and 7/8, Salutation High Rise Legging, Salutation Pintuck High Rise 7/8, Transcend Zero 7/8, Elation Surface Novelty Legging); Transcend High Rise Stirrup Legging $99; Salutation Stash High Rise Legging and 7/8 $109; Salutation Stash Double Up Lift and Headlands Hybrid Cargo Legging $119; Rainier Legging $119-$129; Altitude Edge Stash Legging $129. notes: 2026-10-29 (athleta page run): homepage title 'Shop Athleta for Women's Yoga Clothing, Technical Athletic Clothing, and Athleisure'; meta: 'Athleta designs clothing that integrates performance and technical features for active women and girls'. Search suggestions lead with 'Leggings'; the Bottoms menu has Leggings, a Leggings Guide and a Take the Leggings Quiz page, so C = leggings.

Sizes from the size facet of the Gap Inc. product API for women's leggings (cid 1059481): Regular 00 (XXS/XS) to 18 (XL) plus 16-18 (1X), 20-22 (2X), 24-26 (3X); Tall 0-18; Petite 00-14. has_plus true from 1X-3X.

Shipping (homepage shipping modal text): 'Free shipping for all Core and Premier Members' orders of $50 or more'; All-Access Cardmembers free on $35+; members' orders under $50 ship for $7.50; 'Qualifying items ship for $9.50 for all nonmember orders'. free_shipping_min_usd 50 is the rewards-member threshold (Encore membership). athleta.gapcanada.ca is a separate Canadian store, so ships_to records US.

Returns (cid=79311): '30 Days to Return or Exchange' from delivery (online) or purchase (store); free mail returns for Encore Members, 'A $6 return fee applies to returns by mail from nonmembers'; Premier up to 45 days, All-Access Cardmembers up to 60 (merchandise return card after 30); 'Give-it-a-Workout Guarantee' within 30 days of delivery; final sale excluded. Gap Inc. returns FAQ: returns 'can only be made at the brand of purchase'.

Store locator (athleta.gap.com/stores) lists stores in 44 states plus DC. gapinc.com/en-us/about/athleta: 'Athleta was founded in 1998 to put women first'; certified B Corp in 2018; over 250 stores in the US and Canada; first store Mill Valley, California, 2011. Gap Inc. 10-K (FY ended Jan 31, 2026): 'Athleta is a premium performance lifestyle brand'; 'Founded in 1998 and acquired by Gap Inc. in 2008'; certified B Corp; principal executive offices Two Folsom Street, San Francisco. Wikipedia: Gap Inc. acquired Athleta in 2008.
